schema: rules the bot enforces. kind: affix|monster|aura|boss. action: avoid|kill_first|chicken|skip_area|use_x. difficulty: n=Normal nm=Nightmare h=Hell. Names match monstats/ uniqueaffix names; numeric ids to be filled from data tables (monstats.txt 'hcIdx' / mod ids from UnitAny.mods[9]).

affixes.name: Mana Burn
affixes.reason: drains mana; sorc dependent on mana; fight at range, drink mana pots, leave if mana<10% twice

affixes.name: Cursed
affixes.reason: Amplify Damage / Lower Resist curse on player; Lower Resist elite = skip in Hell

affixes.name: Fire Enchanted
affixes.reason: explode on death for fire damage; kill at range

affixes.name: Lightning Enchanted
affixes.reason: charged lightning + death nova; deadly with low LR

affixes.name: Extra Fast
affixes.reason: fast closers; do not stand still

affixes.name: Stone Skin / Extra Strong / Spectral Hit
affixes.reason: Spectral Hit random elemental; Extra Strong high damage

affixes.name: Teleportation
affixes.reason: teleports onto the bot; do not trade melee

affixes.name: Aura Enchanted: Conviction
affixes.reason: removes resists on player (-lowers to immune-ish); skip pack unless cold pierce

affixes.name: Aura Enchanted: Might/Holy Fire/Holy Freeze/Thorns
affixes.reason: Thorns kills merc and sorc; avoid reflection pack

monsters.name: Dolls (Soul Killer/ Doll)
monsters.reason: explode on death for large damage; do not melee, kill at range >=8 tiles

monsters.name: Souls (Black Soul / Burning Soul)
monsters.reason: drain mana (Black Soul) and fire; kill at range

monsters.name: Poison / Venom Lords, Oblivion Knights
monsters.reason: Oblivion Knight casts Iron Maiden/ Amp Damage / Life Tap; Venom lords poison nova

monsters.name: Blood Hawk / Blood Wing
monsters.reason: fast flyers in Normal Act 2; Static helps

monsters.name: Council Member / Mephisto aura lunges
monsters.reason: Travincal council: kill from edge; Mephisto: use moat with Static+Blizzard

bosses_skip_until.note: cold immune is not an issue; Duriel hits very hard in melee

immunities.detect: read monster resistances from stat list (stat ids 39 fire,41 lightning,43 cold,45 poison, 36 physical, 37 magic) via UnitAny.StatList; value>=100 = immune. Re-check after Lower Resist/curse.

use: Frost Nova/ Glacial Spike if invested

choose_damage.if_immune_to_both: teleport past / abandon pack; cap per-pack time to 40 s
